## Institutions

<a id="armenia-national"></a>

### Հայաստանի ազգային արխիվ

`repository` · [Website / directory](https://www.moj.am/structures/view/structure/40)

The Ministry of Justice describes the National Archives of Armenia and its regional branches and representations. It identifies biographical and genealogical research services and records concerning education, awards, migration, refugees and repatriation. The page’s branch counts are not a named, fully reconciled current roster: verify territorial reorganizations and transfers before choosing a local office.

Holdings: Ministry description lists genealogical and biographical enquiries, migration/refugee/repatriation information, education and awards.

Source: [https://www.moj.am/structures/view/structure/40](https://www.moj.am/structures/view/structure/40) · 2026-11-02 · institutional-page-or-directory-read

<a id="armenia-lori-tavush"></a>

### Լոռու և Տավուշի միասնական մարզային մասնաճյուղ

`branch` · [Website / directory](https://e-gov.am/gov-decrees/item/36480/)

An enacted government decision dated 1 July 2021 transfers Tavush branch functions to Lori and establishes a combined regional branch; it also orders movement of documents. This is a dated custody-reorganization lead, not verification that no later transfer occurred. Newer optimization proposals must be checked for enactment before updating custody.

Source: [https://e-gov.am/gov-decrees/item/36480/](https://e-gov.am/gov-decrees/item/36480/) · 2026-11-02 · institutional-page-or-directory-read

Gaps: Present office and post-2021 changes need reconciliation; a proposed reorganization is not treated as enacted.
